ex.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
ex.zh: 這份作業花了我比預期還久的時間。

ex.en: The assignment is due next Monday.
ex.zh: 這份作業下週一要交。

ex.en: It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
ex.zh: 我們必須同心協力才能完成這項任務。

ex.en: I was abroad on an assignment.
ex.zh: 我那時被派到國外出任務。

ex.en: Students are graded by continuous assessment.
ex.zh: 學生的成績是透過持續評量來決定的。

ex.en: We need a careful assessment of the risks.
ex.zh: 我們需要仔細評估風險。

ex.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
ex.zh: 這個書架很容易組裝。

ex.en: I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
ex.zh: 你寄來的家具組裝說明，我會留著。

ex.en: The teacher assembled the students in the hall.
ex.zh: 老師把學生集合在禮堂。

ex.en: Where are we assembling?
ex.zh: 我們在哪裡集合？

ex.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
ex.zh: 我們必須考慮這項專案的財務層面。

ex.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
ex.zh: 想像力影響我們生活的每個層面。

ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.
ex.zh: 他強調都市生活便利的一面。

ex.en: The furniture requires some assembly.
ex.zh: 這件家具需要自己組裝一下。

ex.en: He works on an assembly line.
ex.zh: 他在生產線上工作。

ex.en: Where is the assembly point?
ex.zh: 集合地點在哪裡？

ex.en: The school holds an assembly every Monday.
ex.zh: 學校每週一舉行朝會。

ex.en: As soon as I sat down, I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 我一坐下就睡著了。

ex.en: I was so excited that I couldn't fall asleep.
ex.zh: 我興奮到睡不著。

ex.en: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
ex.zh: 寶寶在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

ex.en: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
ex.zh: 他向我保證工作會準時完成。

ex.en: We have received assurances from the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們已經得到供應商的保證。

ex.en: She spoke with great assurance.
ex.zh: 她說話非常有自信。

ex.en: He handled the interview with quiet assurance.
ex.zh: 他從容自信地應對面試。

ex.en: She works in quality assurance.
ex.zh: 她在品保部門工作。

ex.en: All products go through quality assurance testing.
ex.zh: 所有產品都要經過品保測試。

ex.en: He asserted that the report was accurate.
ex.zh: 他堅稱報告是正確的。

ex.en: The company asserts that its products are safe.
ex.zh: 公司聲稱其產品很安全。

assert.zh: 維護（權利）；展現（權威）、表現主見

ex.en: You need to assert yourself more in meetings.
ex.zh: 你在會議上要更有主見一點。

ex.en: The new CEO quickly asserted her authority.
ex.zh: 新執行長很快就樹立了權威。

ex.en: He was charged with assault.
ex.zh: 他被控傷害罪。

ex.en: The army launched an assault at dawn.
ex.zh: 軍隊在黎明時發動攻擊。

ex.en: The man was accused of assaulting a security guard.
ex.zh: 那名男子被控攻擊一名警衛。

ex.en: She was assaulted on her way home.
ex.zh: 她在回家的路上遭到襲擊。

ex.en: He applied for political asylum in Canada.
ex.zh: 他向加拿大申請政治庇護。

ex.en: The government granted asylum to the refugees.
ex.zh: 政府給予那些難民庇護。

ex.en: Tom refuted that assertion with a counterexample.
ex.zh: 湯姆用一個反例駁斥了那個說法。

ex.en: There is no evidence to support his assertion.
ex.zh: 沒有證據支持他的說法。

ex.en: As I was leaving, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我正要離開時，電話響了。

ex.en: Prices go up as demand increases.
ex.zh: 隨著需求增加，價格跟著上漲。

ex.en: She works as a designer.
ex.zh: 她擔任設計師。

ex.en: I used the box as a table.
ex.zh: 我把箱子當桌子用。

ex.en: As you know, the office will be closed tomorrow.
ex.zh: 如你所知，辦公室明天不開。

ex.en: Please do it as I showed you.
ex.zh: 請照我示範給你看的方式做。

ex.en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
ex.zh: 你起得沒有你姐姐那麼早。

ex.en: This laptop is as fast as mine.
ex.zh: 這台筆電和我的一樣快。

ex.en: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
ex.zh: 然而，反過來說也永遠成立。

ex.en: I'd like a coffee as well.
ex.zh: 我也想要一杯咖啡。

ex.en: Mr. Sato asked me many questions about the election.
ex.zh: 佐藤先生問了我很多關於選舉的問題。

ex.en: You can ask the child who's playing over there.
ex.zh: 你可以問在那裡玩的那個小孩。

ex.en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
ex.zh: 我請媽媽四點叫我起床。

ex.en: We will help him if he asks us.
ex.zh: 如果他開口，我們就會幫他。

ex.en: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
ex.zh: 不要害怕開口求助。

ex.en: The customer asked for a refund.
ex.zh: 那位顧客要求退款。

ex.en: He asked me to dinner.
ex.zh: 他邀我去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Tom asked Amy to the party.
ex.zh: 湯姆邀請艾咪參加派對。

ex.en: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 我們一提到達爾文就會想到進化論。

ex.en: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
ex.zh: 很多人會把五聲音階和中國音樂聯想在一起。

ex.en: Don't associate yourself with people that give up easily.
ex.zh: 別跟輕易放棄的人來往。

ex.en: I don't want to associate with people like him.
ex.zh: 我不想跟他那種人來往。

ex.en: Dan lied to his associates.
ex.zh: Dan 對他的夥伴說謊。

ex.en: She is a business associate of mine.
ex.zh: 她是我的生意夥伴。

ex.en: He is an associate professor at the university.
ex.zh: 他是那所大學的副教授。

ex.en: She was promoted to associate director last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升為副總監。

ex.en: She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
ex.zh: 她以為大家都會贊成這個計畫。

ex.en: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
ex.zh: 我想你應該不會想那樣做吧。

ex.en: Let's assume this is correct for now.
ex.zh: 我們姑且先假設這是對的。

ex.en: She will assume the role of manager next month.
ex.zh: 她下個月將接任經理一職。

ex.en: The company assumed full responsibility for the error.
ex.zh: 公司為這個錯誤承擔了全部責任。

ex.en: She can assess investments very accurately.
ex.zh: 她能非常準確地評估投資。

ex.en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
ex.zh: 這次面試的目的是評估你是否適合這家公司。

ex.en: We need to assess the damage first.
ex.zh: 我們需要先評估損害情況。

ex.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.
ex.zh: 他擁有超過一百萬美元的資產。

ex.en: The company's total assets are worth 5 billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家公司的總資產價值五十億元。

ex.en: Youth is an asset.
ex.zh: 年輕就是本錢。

ex.en: She is a real asset to our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊不可或缺的人才。

ex.en: I applied for membership in the association.
ex.zh: 我申請加入這個協會。

ex.en: The association counts thirty members.
ex.zh: 這個協會有三十名會員。

ex.en: In Taiwan, red has a strong association with good luck.
ex.zh: 在台灣，紅色常讓人聯想到好運。

ex.en: Some people have bad associations with hospitals.
ex.zh: 有些人對醫院有不好的聯想。

ex.en: The event is organized in association with the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動與市政府合辦。

ex.en: The show was made in association with a local TV station.
ex.zh: 這個節目是和一家地方電視台合作製作的。

ex.en: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
ex.zh: 我當了湯姆三年的助理。

ex.en: I need an assistant who speaks French.
ex.zh: 我需要一位會說法語的助理。

ex.en: I am looking for an assistant.
ex.zh: 我正在找助理。

ex.en: Tom got a job as assistant manager.
ex.zh: 湯姆找到一份副理的工作。

ex.en: He works as an assistant professor.
ex.zh: 他擔任助理教授。

ex.en: What is the basis of your assumptions?
ex.zh: 你的假設是根據什麼？

ex.en: That's a pretty big assumption.
ex.zh: 這個假設未免太大膽了。

ex.en: That's an assumption.
ex.zh: 這只是一個假設。

ex.en: She pulled me aside.
ex.zh: 她把我拉到一旁。

ex.en: He pulled aside to let a truck pass.
ex.zh: 他把車靠邊讓卡車通過。

ex.en: Joking aside, how are things going?
ex.zh: 說正經的，事情進展得如何？

aside.zh: put / set aside：擱置；存下、撥出（錢或時間）

ex.en: She put aside the sewing and stood up.
ex.zh: 她放下手邊的針線活，站了起來。

ex.en: I set aside some money every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月都存一點錢。

ex.en: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
ex.zh: 但你知道，除了這些我什麼都沒有。

ex.en: Aside from the price, I like everything about it.
ex.zh: 除了價格之外，其他我都很滿意。

ex.en: Thank you for your assistance.
ex.zh: 謝謝您的協助。

ex.en: Do you need our assistance?
ex.zh: 您需要我們協助嗎？

ex.en: Your assistance is indispensable for us.
ex.zh: 您的協助對我們來說不可或缺。

ex.en: I assure you that the problem will be fixed today.
ex.zh: 我向您保證問題今天就會解決。

ex.en: The manager assured us that the order would arrive on time.
ex.zh: 經理向我們保證訂單會準時送達。

ex.en: Rest assured, your data is safe with us.
ex.zh: 請放心，您的資料在我們這裡很安全。

ex.en: Rest assured that we will handle the problem.
ex.zh: 請放心，我們會處理這個問題。

ex.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
ex.zh: 我想請你幫我整理花園。

ex.en: I'm here to assist you.
ex.zh: 我是來協助您的。

ex.en: I'll be able to assist you.
ex.zh: 我可以協助您。

ex.en: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
ex.zh: 我對自己做的事感到很羞愧。

ex.en: I'm not ashamed of my father being poor.
ex.zh: 我不會因為父親窮而感到丟臉。

ex.en: She was ashamed of herself for her carelessness.
ex.zh: 她為自己的粗心感到羞愧。

ex.en: The cars move slowly along the assembly line.
ex.zh: 汽車沿著裝配線緩緩移動。

ex.en: He worked on an assembly line for ten years.
ex.zh: 他在生產線上工作了十年。

ex.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.
ex.zh: 我老闆把艱鉅的任務指派給了我。

ex.en: She assigned the work to him.
ex.zh: 她把這個工作派給他做。

ex.en: The teacher assigned us ten problems for homework.
ex.zh: 老師出了十題作業給我們。
